cases.proposition: Three coordinated growth lanes balance near-term cash, scalable expansion, and long-horizon options.
cases.explanatory_lead: The portfolio is designed as one coordinated system rather than three unrelated initiatives.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: fund the lanes with different horizons but govern them through one portfolio cadence.

page_plan.page_purpose: Explain how three growth lanes form one governed portfolio.

primary_relationship.description: Read three parallel portfolio lanes from mandate through evidence to management implication.
primary_relationship.visual_instruction: Connect the three lanes at shared governance decisions and finish at the portfolio takeaway.

page_plan.reading_path: Read each lane left to right, then converge on shared governance.

cases.proposition: A five-stage capital loop converts disciplined screening into repeatable value realization.
cases.explanatory_lead: Each stage produces the evidence and decision needed by the next stage, closing the operating loop.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: returns depend on the closed-loop discipline, not on isolated deal selection.

page_plan.page_purpose: Explain how five capital stages close into one operating loop.

primary_relationship.description: Follow one clockwise capital loop from sourcing to screening, investment, value creation, and realization.
primary_relationship.visual_instruction: Attach one evidence note and one management implication to each transition.

page_plan.reading_path: Read clockwise from sourcing through realization and back to sourcing.

cases.proposition: Four linked capabilities turn fragmented operations into a measurable transformation engine.
cases.explanatory_lead: The chain explains how enabling capabilities compound rather than presenting four independent workstreams.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: transformation value appears only when all four capabilities connect into daily operations.

page_plan.page_purpose: Explain how four capabilities compound into measurable transformation.

primary_relationship.description: Read a four-capability chain from data foundation through decision intelligence and operating adoption to measurable outcomes.
primary_relationship.visual_instruction: Show cause, interpretation, and outcome at each handoff.

page_plan.reading_path: Read from the data foundation through adoption to measurable outcomes.

cases.proposition: A four-row investment matrix makes risk-return trade-offs comparable and decision-ready.
cases.explanatory_lead: Common comparison logic reveals why superficially similar opportunities require different capital decisions.
cases.takeaway: Takeaway: prioritize the options with evidence-backed upside and controllable execution risk.

page_plan.page_purpose: Compare four investment options using one decision logic.

primary_relationship.description: Read four investment rows against the same evidence, interpretation, risk, and decision columns.
primary_relationship.visual_instruction: Use a single comparison spine and end with the portfolio decision.

page_plan.reading_path: Read each row across the common decision columns, then compare priorities.
